svg.title: LMS and course storefront — relational database diagram
svg.desc: Four service-owned PostgreSQL databases with crow's-foot cardinalities. A reference map lists cross-service identifiers. Notification, AI search, and security audit records appear below.
svg.text: One parent per child · zero or more children per parent

g.title: app_user: one per membership, zero or more children
app_user: one per external_identity, zero or more children
organization: one per membership, zero or more children
organization: one per sso_connection, zero or more children
membership: one per role_grant, zero or more children
role: one per role_grant, zero or more children
role: one per role_permission, zero or more children
permission: one per role_permission, zero or more children
course: one per course_release, zero or more children
course_release: one per section, zero or more children
course: one per course_staff, zero or more children
course: one per offer, zero or more children
section: one per lesson, zero or more children
lesson: one per media_asset, zero or more children

g.text: A release fixes the structure used by enrollments.
An offer sets the price and duration of course access.

g.title: purchase_order: one per order_line, zero or more children
purchase_order: one per payment_attempt, zero or more children
purchase_order: one per outbox_event, zero or more children
order_line: one per refund_line, zero or more children
payment_attempt: one per refund, zero or more children
refund: one per refund_line, zero or more children
enrollment: one per lesson_progress, zero or more children
enrollment: one per certificate, zero or more children
enrollment: one per attempt, zero or more children
assessment: one per attempt, zero or more children

g.text: A grant authorizes playback for its learner and course.
An enrollment records study on a particular release.

svg.text: Each arrow points from the external record to the fields that refer to it. Services resolve these IDs through APIs or events.
Outbox and inbox rows correlate by event_key. The broker, payment provider and audit targets keep their own identifiers.
